title: NFL power rankings: Who's having best offseason so far? Vikings' Kyler Murray signing might not be the elixir it seems

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL power rankings: Who's having best offseason so far? Vikings' Kyler Murray signing might not be the elixir it seems
sources.description: Yes, Murray comes cheap to Minnesota, but any optimism about him turning things around is based on potential rather than résumé. The Vikings haven't had a good offseason. The vibes are much different elsewhere, like in Vegas, Denver and Los Angeles.
